support_spans: Cerebrospinal fluid culture grew Enterococcus gallinarum
candidates.why: The presence of Enterococcus gallinarum in the cerebrospinal fluid culture suggests a possible infectious cause.

candidates.name: Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE) flare
contradict_spans: no focal neurologic deficits or clinical signs of lupus activity
candidates.why: The patient's history of SLE and current symptoms such as systemic inflammatory response syndrome and proteinuria suggest a possible SLE flare.

candidates.name: Diffuse Alveolar Hemorrhage (DAH)
support_spans: bilateral patchy pulmonary infiltrates on chest radiograph
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms such as hemoptysis, bilateral patchy pulmonary infiltrates, and drop in hemoglobin concentration are consistent with DAH.

candidates.name: Nosocomial Pneumonia
support_spans: bilateral patchy pulmonary infiltrates on chest radiograph
acute respiratory failure requiring mechanical ventilation
contradict_spans: The initial clinical diagnosis was diffuse alveolar hemorrhage caused by SLE activity without sufficient clinical criteria of nosocomial pneumonia
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms such as bilateral patchy pulmonary infiltrates and acute respiratory failure suggest a possible nosocomial pneumonia.

candidates.name: Invasive aspergillosis
support_spans: bilateral patchy pulmonary infiltrates on chest radiograph
